`types.d.ts` is the unmodified, generated JavaScript runtime declaration file
from PocketBase v0.40.6, matching `PB_VERSION` in `Dockerfile.pocketbase`.
It is covered by the adjacent upstream MIT license.

Source: https://github.com/pocketbase/pocketbase/blob/v0.40.6/plugins/jsvm/internal/types/generated/types.d.ts

Update this file from the matching PocketBase release when upgrading the runtime.
Application types belong in the TypeScript source under `hooks/`.
